general.llm_summary: The discovery set is catalyst-heavy but mixed: AI infrastructure and enterprise AI adoption are the clearest constructive themes, while several high-profile earnings reactions show investors punishing guidance or revenue misses. APP and FLUT carry the sharpest downside signals after post-earnings declines and estimate or guidance pressure, while ACM and CTSH look better supported by backlog, AI demand, and operating commentary. ThetaData confirmation was generally unavailable, so confidence rests on news directness rather than options-flow validation.

Q2 commentary cited $5.5B revenue and accelerating AI adoption in financial services, supporting a direct enterprise-AI demand read.
RBC and Truist maintained bullish ratings and raised price targets, though the setup is tempered by later commentary about minimal near-term revenue growth.

Flutter cut full-year 2026 revenue guidance and sold off, while Citi's upgrade was only to neutral and came with a lower $93 target.
Software names including INTU were pressured after Figma highlighted rising AI-related R&D and operating costs, creating margin-risk read-through.
